title: Стоит потраченного усилия
description: Стоит потраченного усилия: применяем правило в новых ситуациях, разбираем словарь, диалог и авторский текст без аудирования.
objectives: Не принимать положительную оценку за отсутствие издержек
notes: Worth checking означает «стоит проверить», без to перед действием.
Worth the effort допускает наличие усилий и затрат; фраза оценивает их оправданность.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: The archive is worth ___ even if the search takes time.
Вставь слово из пары: checking / check.

public_payload.sentence: It is worth ___ the original record.

exercises.editorial_answer: It is worth checking the original record.
The original documents are worth checking.
exercises.explanation: Worth checking выражает оценку полезности действия, не его завершение.

exercises.prompt: Исправь ошибку в указанной конструкции, сохраняя остальные слова и смысл.

public_payload.sentence: The proposal is worth to discuss.

exercises.incorrect_answer: The proposal is worth to discuss.

exercises.prompt: Что означает worthwhile в данном случае?

public_payload.passage: The researcher described a visit to the regional archive as worthwhile. A colleague assumed that the visit must therefore have been quick and inexpensive. In fact, the journey took most of a day, and several files were irrelevant. One document nevertheless resolved an important uncertainty. The researcher’s judgement weighed that benefit against the time and cost; it did not deny that the cost existed. The report also distinguished finding a useful lead from having completed every part of the wider research.

options.label: The visit required no time or money.
The benefit justified the effort despite real costs.

exercises.editorial_answer: The benefit justified the effort despite real costs.

exercises.explanation: В этих контекстах: worthwhile — стоящий усилий; effort — усилие; benefit — польза; cost — затраты.
